scope: Complete recorded empty normal-10pt FormattedDocumentField widgets: default/two explicit sizes, ReadOnly, Enabled, BorderColor, title hidden and native-ignored BackColor/ShowToolbar requests. Ten native sources, seventeen complete-widget samples per locale. Full forms and other property/state/display matrices remain open.

nativeInputs.scope: Ten measured empty normal-10pt FormattedDocumentField inputs on native ru/en; recorded complete widget cases are calibrated, other properties/profiles and full forms remain open.

surface.backColor: Retained in native field XML but does not change the empty design-time document body.
surface.showToolbar: Removed by native field export; true and false requests leave the same empty surface.

nativeMetricsChangedAfterFreeze: Explanatory scope/acceptance metadata only; all XML, rows, dimensions and RGB hashes are unchanged.

implementation.sharedDimensions: FormattedDocumentField is the fourth independently measured consumer of documentSurfaceMetrics: 500x243 default, 200x118 for Width20/Height5, 350x218 for Width35/Height9.
implementation.body: The complete empty native body is white, including ReadOnly/Enabled and BackColor=web:Black. BackColor is retained in canonical native XML but does not change this static surface.
implementation.outerBorder: Normal/ReadOnly retain active BorderColor; Enabled=false uses #e8e8e8. Blue BorderColor is accepted.
implementation.toolbar: ShowToolbar true/false is removed by native field export and leaves the same empty widget. Both requested XML and canonical exports are retained. The unmeasured prototype formatted toolbar and its unused CSS are removed.
implementation.applicabilityLimit: Other formatted-document field properties, runtime document formatting, the full typed-property inventory and computed-property inspector semantics in T152/T155 remain open.
